title: Popper
description: Low-level positioned layer anchored to an element, used to build menus, dropdowns and popovers.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Popper is controlled: pass anchorEl and visible, update visibility in onVisibleChange and close with onClickAway.

placements.title: Placements
placements.description: Twelve placements around the anchor. With trigger="manual" you decide when it opens.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: Click, hover, focus or right-click on the anchor requests a visibility change.

variants.title: Variants and arrow
variants.description: Color variants with an arrow pointing at the anchor.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: type="menu" gives the popper role="menu" for lists of actions.

sizes.title: Sizes and scrolling
sizes.description: Preset sizes with fixed dimensions; long content wraps with multiline and scrolls with scrollable.

custom-style.title: Custom style
custom-style.description: Customize colors, dimensions, offset, transition and z-index.

PopperProps.anchorEl: Element the popper is positioned against
PopperProps.type: Functional type; "menu" sets role="menu", otherwise role="dialog"
PopperProps.arrow: Shows an arrow pointing at the anchor
PopperProps.onClickAway: Called on mousedown outside both the popper and the anchor
PopperProps.multiline: Allows text to wrap onto multiple lines
PopperProps.trigger: Anchor interaction that requests a visibility change via onVisibleChange
PopperProps.onVisibleChange: Called with the requested visibility when the trigger fires
PopperProps.scrollable: Lets the content scroll when it overflows
PopperProps.width: Fixed width, overriding the size preset
PopperProps.height: Fixed height, overriding the size preset
